translation_direction: bn → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Bengali electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Light, systematic foreign marking (Babu, salaam, tui, small grammatical slips) in his early speech; standard tôi after prison (1.51–1.60), as Tagore’s Bengali becomes more standard there.
decisions.rationale: Signals a foreigner without caricature or in-text explanation.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: The শ্বশুরবাড়ি jail euphemism was lost; Rahamat, arrested with tied hands, now answers “Thì đang đi nhà chồng đây nè!”, letting the double meaning surface through the scene without an in-text gloss.
Rahamat’s broken Bengali had been rendered as fluent native Vietnamese; now marked by Babu, salaam, tui and small grammatical slips, with a deliberate shift to tôi after prison.
মারিতাম is conditional (‘I would hit him’): Tui đánh bố chồng liền, mà làm sao được — tay bị trói rồi.
The needless চন্দ্রবিন্দু joke rendered with a needless Vietnamese tilde: “Või!”.
The sixteen-anna pun is carried in the wording (đáng giá trọn cả đồng rupi mười sáu anna) rather than an explanation.
মঙ্গল-আলোক contrasted with the forgone electric lights: thứ ánh sáng của phúc lành.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The bride’s marital home; Rahamat’s jail euphemism has no Vietnamese slang equivalent, so the arrest scene (1.39–1.40) carries it through his own joke.
Rahamat’s foreign address form is kept as Babu; his little girl is bé.

witness_decision: Selected the validated (proofread level 4) Bengali Wikisource transcription of গল্পগুচ্ছ, vol. 1 (Visva-Bharati; new edition 1353 / 1946, scanned reprint 1357), scan pages 188–198. First published in সাধনা, অগ্রহায়ণ 1299 B.S. (1892). The editors’ periodical date after the story is apparatus and is excluded; one missing opening quotation mark in the witness (passage 1.23) is supplied only in the translation.

title_review.rationale: Người Kabul names Rahamat as the narrator and the household see him, a man from Kabul; it keeps the body term and avoids the peddler’s trade suffix -wala, which has no neat Vietnamese equivalent.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Compared Mini, the first meetings, the bag joke, the half-rupee and the father-in-law jokes.
Compared the arrest, the years after and the wedding preparations.
Compared Rahamat’s return, the handprint, Mini as bride and the gift.
